design: A: one weekly omnibus crawl (Mon) + resume-only catch-up of the same workflow (Tue); per-store Shopify backoff + deferred rounds (#62), 170-min fetch deadline, open_run resume, refused labelling.

simulation.how: build/arch-compare/A/sim: mockweek.py (copy of crawl-plan mockserver + SCENARIO faults), weekjob.py runs the worktree's ingest.open_run/select_states/run(deadline)/retry-failed pass, runweek.py drives the week, analyze.py computes metrics. 2,545 profiles, clock x10, 32 workers. Probe, enrich, dbt build not simulated; gates approximated in SQL (run_is_complete, run_ok_rate 0.9, adapter_ok_rate 0.5).

placements.calendar: faults on the SCENARIO days: day-3 Woo outage and day-5 kill find no A job running
placements.drill: same faults moved onto A's Monday job: Woo 503 for its first 2 h, SIGKILL at 50%; Tuesday resumes

caveats: 4 cores shared with other agents' sims: scaled wall times are upper-ish estimates
job wall = ingest only (main + deferred rounds + retry-failed pass); discovery/probe/enrich/dbt add time
S2 bucket counts every Shopify request (429s too) over a trailing 60 s
